name: TNFR1 signaling restraining apoptotic and necroptotic death
rationale: All members concern TNFR1 signal output (NF-kB, proapoptotic arm, LUBAC linear ubiquitination); unlike the NF-kB-focused confusables, the theme carries negative regulation of death-receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and TNF signaling.

qualifier: tooth formation and ectopic calcification disorders
name: Tooth mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover enamel/dentin mineralization, tooth eruption, phosphate transport and calcification diseases (PXE, IBGC1, amelogenesis imperfecta); the dental context separates it from confusables on bicarbonate, renal phosphate homeostasis and bone mineralization.

qualifier: with ureteric bud and ureter development
name: Nephron morphogenesis with ureteric bud and ureter development
rationale: All members describe embryonic kidney morphogenesis (comma/S-shaped bodies, nephron tubules); mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and ureter development distinguish it from confusables focused on tubule segment patterning and mesenchymal-epithelial transition.

qualifier: direct alkylation reversal and base excision gap-filling
name: Alkylation damage reversal and base excision gap-filling
rationale: Members are direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT) and the polymerase gap-filling steps of short- and long-patch BER; confusables lack either the gap-filling steps or the direct reversal enzymes and instead have glycosylase or TET demethylation steps.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix, ILK complex and Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibers
name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion and Rho-driven stress fiber remodeling
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan adhesion to matrix coupled to ILK-PINCH-parvin and Rho-ROCK/PAK actin remodeling; fibronectin matrix formation, stress fiber assembly and the IPP complex distinguish it from spreading/migration and platelet confusables.

name: Interferon-alpha-induced antiviral gene signature
rationale: All members are type I IFN/interferon-alpha antiviral response sets (OAS, IRF2 targets, IP-10, cytosolic DNA sensing); the ISG transcriptional signature separates it from ISG15, RIG-I regulation and dengue confusables.

name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic cell death and mitochondrial depolarization triggered by hydrogen peroxide, oxidative stress, hypoxia and oxygen-glucose deprivation; confusables instead centre on MOMP/cytochrome c, respiration or ferroptosis.

qualifier: with erythrocyte oxygen and gas transport
name: Iron and heme uptake with erythrocyte oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover iron import, transferrin cycling, heme scavenging and iron-overload disorders together with erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and NO transport; it lacks the heme biosynthesis and erythropoiesis of its nearest confusable and the cadmium/ammonium transport of others.

name: Mitochondrial genome replication, expression and tRNA processing
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, mitoribosome assembly and translation plus tRNA end processing and splicing; confusables are instead tRNA/rRNA modification and aminoacylation sets.

qualifier: CHD/NuRD remodeling, deacetylation and retroelement silencing
name: CHD/NuRD and HDAC chromatin repression with retroelement silencing
rationale: Members are corepressor chromatin machinery (NuRD, CHD subfamilies, HDACs, MECP2-NCoR, SUMOylated cofactors, X inactivation); KRAB-ZFP and HUSH retroelement silencing distinguish it from confusables dominated by BAF, HAT and methylation complexes.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and cGAS-STING regulation
rationale: Members describe IRF3 activation of type I IFN and regulation of IFN-beta production/response and cGAS-STING; confusables carry RIG-I/MDA5 sensing or IFN-alpha/OAS responses instead.

qualifier: UDP-sugar synthesis, Golgi transport and N-glycan trimming
name: UDP-sugar synthesis and Golgi transport for N-glycan processing
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc/UDP-glucose/UDP-glucuronate synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport and their CDGs, and N-glycan trimming; confusables focus on sialic acid/fucose/O-glycans, GPI anchors or dolichol-linked ALG assembly.

qualifier: ribosomal frameshifting and host translation control
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and ribosomal frameshifting
rationale: Members concern SARS-CoV replicase polyprotein translation and maturation, programmed frameshifting and modulation of host translation elongation; confusables cover genome replication, capping or influenza RNA synthesis.

core: Lipid modification and lipid transfer in secretory trafficking
qualifier: Wnt and RAB lipidation with ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer
name: Wnt and RAB lipidation with ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer
rationale: Members combine PORCN-dependent Wnt secretion, RAB geranylgeranylation/activation, PI synthesis and ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer with Golgi secretion; confusables lack the Wnt secretion arm or the phospholipid-transfer arm and carry glycolipid or RAS processing instead.

name: Vitamin B12 absorption and transport and their defects
rationale: All members concern cobalamin uptake by intrinsic factor and cubam, transcobalamin transport and lysosomal export and their deficiency diseases; confusables cover intracellular cobalamin metabolism or other vitamins.

core: Protein exit from the endoplasmic reticulum
name: ER protein exit and retrotranslocation to cytosol
rationale: Members are protein export from the ER and its regulation, including ER-to-cytosol retrograde transport; confusables are COPII/COPI vesicle traffic, ERAD quality control or SRP-dependent ER targeting.

qualifier: OTU and USP proteases with ubiquitin activation
name: OTU and USP deubiquitinases with ubiquitin activation
rationale: Members are deubiquitinase activities (OTU, USP; K48/K11 chain removal, opposing K63 chains) plus E1/E2 ubiquitin activation; confusables carry UCH or metalloprotease DUBs, E3 ligation or NF-kB regulation.

qualifier: cobalamin uptake with thiamine and riboflavin metabolism
name: Cobalamin transport with thiamine and riboflavin metabolism
rationale: Members combine cobalamin absorption/transport and its defects with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism; confusables have intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E/ubiquinol instead.

name: Protein methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor hypermodification
rationale: Members are residue-level modifications (lysine/arginine methylation, histone demethylation, lysine/proline hydroxylation) plus hypusine, diphthamide and wybutosine; confusables carry polyamine metabolism, translation termination or initiation instead.

name: Cadherin transcription and morphogen signaling in mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members link regulation of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19 expression and FGFR2 splicing with TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signaling and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation; confusables centre on osteoblast differentiation or transcriptional repression.

name: Apical epithelial membrane targeting and CFTR trafficking
rationale: Members concern apical surface protein localization, raft targeting, CFTR trafficking/disease and transepithelial water transport; confusables carry basolateral secretion, bile lipid translocation or pH-sensing channels.

name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and receptor clearance with SREBP/LXR and ABC-transporter cholesterol control; confusables are bile acid synthesis/signaling and vitamin E transport.

name: Neurexin-neuroligin synapse assembly and postsynaptic receptor clustering
rationale: Members describe neurexin-neuroligin-driven pre/postsynaptic assembly, clustering of GABA-A, NMDA, gephyrin and PSD-95 and resulting excitatory/inhibitory transmission; confusables are RPTP and SALM synaptic adhesion sets.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter escape, pausing and elongation control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination; Pol II specificity separates it from confusables dominated by Pol I/III, rRNA processing, HIV transcription and splicing.

name: Responses to reactive oxygen, nitrogen and sulfur species
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide, nitric oxide, nitrosative stress, hydrogen sulfide and ischemia, including oxidative-stress apoptosis; nitrogen/sulfur species distinguish it from confusables on respiration, ferroptosis and UPRmt.
